title: The Lord's Forestructure and the Four Ages of Separation
description: T47 unfolds a litany of "beforehand-before" clauses: before any disorder breaks forth in the soul, the Lord has already shaped a holding-place fitted to it. Before the boundary of natural perceptions was drawn, the wall in the great sea was raised; before the disordered natural fell into the molding sea, a place between the four winds was established; before Error was driven out, structures were set to grasp it; before the failed productions fell, dwellings were prepared; the holding exists before the thing held. T48 extends this to every separation: before what is given and what is claimed had ever been distinguished, the Lord's call was already going forth and set at its post; before truth could rise, the conveyances were already adorned; before sin grew great, discrimination was already on its throne; before falsity made itself felt, the blessed Anointed was appointed; before any human state was begotten, the orbit was fitted; before any loosing, the operations of release were already given their authority.
